phases.text: Steep turn, lateral G +0.05: tone pans right
Steep turn, lateral G -0.05: tone pans left

checks.name: Tone choice follows Gen2 rules
checks.detail: 7983/7983 cycles match updateTones() (2 cycles sit exactly on a setpoint, 16 in the injected sensor fault)

checks.name: AOA matches the probe's true AOA (steady flight)
checks.detail: max error 0.09 deg over 1573 steady cycles

checks.name: AOA matches Gen2 math cycle by cycle (incl. manoeuvres)
checks.detail: max difference 0.046 deg, mean 0.0038 deg over 7278 cycles vs an independent Gen2 re-implementation

checks.name: Pressure spikes rejected by median filter
checks.detail: largest AOA step between 20 ms cycles 0.13 deg with 82 injected spikes

checks.name: Airspeed from pressure sensor
checks.detail: max IAS error 0.6 kt above 40 kt (allowing the 0.24 s pressure filter delay)

checks.name: Display sentences decode on the M5Stack parser
checks.detail: 1601/1601 sentences: 80 bytes, checksum valid

checks.name: G5 EFIS sentences received
checks.detail: 1601 of 1601 G5 frames parsed on the board, 0 CRC failures

checks.name: Display attitude comes from the G5
checks.detail: max pitch difference G5 vs display 0.10 deg

checks.name: Audio: Cruise, AOA 1.5: silent
checks.detail: sound on 0.0% of the time

checks.name: Audio: L/Dmax, AOA ~9.5: low-tone pulses
checks.detail: 401 Hz, measured 7.0 pulses/s vs 5.8 commanded

checks.name: Audio: OnSpeed, AOA 12.5: solid low tone (incl. a 0.2 s sensor dropout)
checks.detail: 401 Hz, sound on 99% of the time

checks.name: Audio: Slow, AOA ~15: high-tone pulses
checks.detail: 1604 Hz, measured 3.8 pulses/s vs 3.7 commanded

checks.name: Audio: Stall warning, AOA 17.5: 20 pulses/s
checks.detail: 1603 Hz, measured 20.0 pulses/s vs 20.0 commanded

checks.name: Audio: Taxi under 25 kt: muted
checks.detail: sound on 0.0% of the time

checks.name: 3D audio pans with the slip ball
checks.detail: ball right: R/L level 7.47, ball left: L/R level 7.48

checks.name: Flap position selects flaps-20 curve and setpoints
checks.detail: flaps {20} and solid OnSpeed tone throughout the approach

checks.name: Short sensor dropout rides through
checks.detail: 10 failed Pfwd reads, no fault raised, solid tone held; 2663 stale-status reads accepted

checks.name: Failed sensor mutes the tones, then recovers
checks.detail: P45 diagnostic status from 61.0 s: fault raised at 61.48 s, tones off while faulted, cleared at 61.80 s, OnSpeed tone back by 62.6 s

checks.name: MakerPlane EFIS (CAN-FiX): AOA out
checks.detail: 1598 AOA frames decoded by python-canfix, max error 0.005 deg; 161 node status frames (1 Hz)

checks.name: MakerPlane EFIS (CAN-FiX): attitude in
checks.detail: 1601/1601 cycles: the board's CAN-FiX decoder holds the EFIS pitch/roll the simulator sent

checks.name: On-board AHRS, straight flight
checks.detail: max pitch error 1.03 deg, roll 0.72 deg over 1276 cycles at constant speed (incl. the IMU's 10 mg offset, about 0.6 deg)

checks.name: On-board AHRS, steady 45 deg turn
checks.detail: max pitch error 0.99 deg, roll 0.39 deg over 347 cycles
